requirements.text: Users should receive immediate notifications after transactions, detailing the amount spent, merchant location, and updated account balance.
Users should have the ability to freeze their debit or credit card directly within the app with a simple button press.
The app should provide a monthly breakdown of spending categorized by type to help users track their financial habits.
Users should be able to set budgets for different spending categories, with alerts for nearing or exceeding those budgets.
The app should feature a clean, straightforward interface that is easy to navigate.
The app should include quick login options like fingerprint or facial recognition.
The app must ensure users feel safe when using it and protect their information.
